tool.name: Kettlebell Selector
tool.tagline: Find the right bells to start with

config.description: Four quick questions. You get the three bells to build your set around, lightest to heaviest.

questions.question: Which chart should we use?
questions.help: The selection chart scales differently for male and female lifters.

questions.question: Roughly where does your bodyweight sit?
questions.help: Used only to scale the load — nothing else.

options.label: Beginner
options.description: New to kettlebells, or coming back after a long break.

options.label: Intermediate or above
options.description: You already swing, clean and press with confidence.

questions.question: How's your general fitness right now?

options.label: Low
options.description: Little or no consistent training in recent months.

scenarios.headline: Start with 8 kg
scenarios.summary: Begin on the lightest bell and earn the next one. Technique first, load second.
notes: Bell 1 — 8 kg: your On Ramp and skill-work bell.
Bell 2 — 12 kg: your main working bell through the phases.
Bell 3 — 16 kg: heavy swings and later-phase strength work.
Buy them in order. One good bell beats three you can't control.
